messages:
joanne: Heads up — EdgeWave SI goes live in the marketplace next Tue. We need a concrete partner escalation path and a short ops script for SEV1/SEV2. Can we lock this down by EOD?
priya: +1. We should avoid a full public channel for every incident. Proposal: shared channel only for SEV1s (critical customer impact) and ephemeral warroom links for SEV2s.
sam: Agree. For SEV1: shared channel + immediate bridge + page on-call SRE. For SEV2: partner tag, ops triage in private, escalate to shared if customer-facing.
marco: Quick note on partner access — marketplace shared_channel has to be whitelisted. We'll need partner emails and contact liaisons ahead of time. Priya, can you collect?
priya: Yes, I'll get EdgeWave contacts and add to the whitelist doc. Also will confirm whether they need read-only or full post permissions.
bryan: We should also define what qualifies as SEV1 vs SEV2 for partners. My suggestion: SEV1 = service down or data loss for paying customers; SEV2 = degraded performance impacting SLAs but workaround exists.
joanne: Sounds good. Let's codify the ladder:
- SEV1: partner_shared_channel (auto-created), bridge with both orgs, page on-call SRE, notify Sales AM and Partner Success.
- SEV2: partner-private-thread, INVITE partner liaison if triage requires, escalate to shared_channel after 30m if unresolved.
sam: I'll add auto-bridge creation into our deploy-bot: command "/bridge create partner-edgewave --ephemeral" that makes partner-edgewave-warroom and invites whitelisted partner accounts.
deploy-bot: bridge created: #partner-edgewave-warroom (expires in 72h) — invites sent to edgewave.contact@edgewave.com
marco: Ops script draft for SEV1 (pasteable):
```
1) Confirm incident severity and impacted customers.
2) Run: `rts status partner-edgewave` to get topology.
3) `/bridge create partner-edgewave --mode=shared`
4) Page @eng-sre on-call: `pager duty: SEV1 partner-edgewave`
5) Post starter message in bridge (see template below)
```
joanne: Starter message template (use in bridge):
"Hi everyone — SEV1 declared for EdgeWave integration. Impact: X% requests failing for merchant IDs 1234/5678. Triage leads: @sam (SRE), @marco (Support), @priya (Partner Success). Current ETA for initial triage: 15m. Logs: https://logs.redwood/integrations/edgewave/incident-{{id}}. Please avoid prolonged threads here — keep updates short (what, who, ETA)."
priya: Also add a customer comms gate: no public comms until PS/Sales OK. Partner success owns the comms template.
bryan: Need an explicit fallback: if shared_channel can't be created (whitelist delay) — fallback path is: 1) create private warroom, 2) add partner POC via invite link, 3) escalate to partner Slack workspace DM + conference bridge (Zoom) created by deploy-bot.
sam: Add automation rule: if bridge creation fails, bot posts: "BRIDGE_FAILED" and @eng-sre on-call is auto-paged with instructions to start manual bridge.
marco: Quick checklist for triage posts (to pin in channel):
• Impact summary (1 line)
• Steps taken
• Next action owner
• ETA
• Clear "handoff" call when resolving

joanne: Security/observability notes: avoid posting secrets. Use short links to logs and include sanitized trace ids. For air-gapped or private deployments, follow Private deployment onboarding doc — partner warroom must be on customer side only.
priya: I'll draft the partner add form and whitelist spreadsheet and share by EOD.
sam: I'll add the bot automation (bridge create + BRIDGE_FAILED pager) and a lightweight runbook in eng-runbooks repo.
marco: I'll create a quick training slide for Support + PS on the escalation ladder and run a 15-minute dry run on Fri.
joanne: Perfect — owners: Priya (partner whitelist + comms), Sam (automation + runbook), Marco (support training), Bryan (severity definitions). We'll reconvene after dry run. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
